In certain circumstances, the Company may pay finder’s fees in cash and warrants on a portion of the Private Placement.

Terra intends to use the proceeds of the Private Placement to pay for: i) executing a ground geophysical survey at the Cumavici target, and ii) commencing the Phase IV drilling program at Cumavici within its Viogor project in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and iii) for working capital purposes.
Terra Balcanica is a silver and antimony-focused polymetallic exploration company targeting large-scale mineral systems in the Balkans of southeastern Europe

The Company has 100% interest in the Viogor Project in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina. Terra owns a 39.5% stake in Terra North Resources Corp. and its Canadian assets that comprise a 100% optioned portfolio of uranium-prospective claims surrounding the world-renowned Athabasca basin. The Company emphasizes responsible engagement with local communities and stakeholders. It is committed to proactively implementing Good International Industry Practice (GIIP) and sustainable health, safety, and environmental management.
